population.span: consecutive adult patients admitted for elective cardiac surgeries randomly received a 1-mg dose of colchicine (n = 81) or placebo (n = 71) orally 12 to 24 hours before surgery followed by a daily dose of 0.5 mg until hospital discharge.

endpoint.span: The primary efficacy endpoint was the development of at least one episode of AF (lasting 5 minutes or longer) occurring after cardiac surgery at any point during hospitalization.

estimate.span: The rate of AF was 16.0% (n = 13) in the colchicine group, versus 18.3% (n = 13) in the placebo group. Comparing the colchicine and placebo groups, the odds ratio was 0.85 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.37–1.99).

ci.span: Comparing the colchicine and placebo groups, the odds ratio was 0.85 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.37–1.99).

treatment_strategy.span: Upon enrollment, patients were treated with 1 mg of colchicine or matching placebo 12 to 24 hours prior to surgery, followed by colchicine (0.5 mg) or placebo immediately after their surgery (via a nasogastric tube) and daily treatment at this dose until hospital discharge.

follow_up.span: The primary efficacy endpoint was the development of at least one episode of AF (lasting 5 minutes or longer) occurring after cardiac surgery at any point during hospitalization.

absent_reason: analysis_set: No source explicitly identifies the endpoint analysis as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, or all randomized. Inclusion of all six patients who died is stated, but does not explicitly establish the complete analysis set.
served_mismatch: The served arm-level counts match the source. However, the reported 0.85 (95% CI 0.37–1.99) is an OR, whereas the served estimand is RR; this estimate and CI cannot be used as an RR. The served intention-to-treat label is not explicitly supported. The abstract prints 16.1% for colchicine, while the full-text main outcome prints 16.0%; both report 13 events.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults undergoing elective cardiac surgery fall within the question's population; ITT describes an analysis set and is not explicitly established.
entry_population_matches_question.span: All consecutive adult patients undergoing elective open-heart surgeries were screened for inclusion.

notes: Full-text spans used throughout. Bound the reported OR and its CI; no RR or RR CI was calculated. Arm denominators are stated in the population span.
